Rajkumar Harsoor Capital Markets Operations & Transformation | Custody & Securities Operations | Team Leadership

raj_rh2004@yahoo.co.in | +91- 9148480428 | Bangalore, India https:// www.linkedin.com/in/rajkumarharsoor

SUMMARY Securities Operations professional with 18+ years at JPMorgan Chase and Credit Suisse / UBS, combining seven years directing trade processing and settlement operations with a decade driving settlement platform, regulatory and control change. Deep end-to-end trade lifecycle expertise across cross-border and domestic markets, from trade capture through matching, settlement, fails and exception management. Proven ownership of cash, position and suspense reconciliations, daily key controls and regulatory reporting, partnering across Corporate Actions, Securities Lending, Fund Services, Reconciliations, Front Office, Middle Office, custodians, brokers and CSDs. Leads teams with a control-first mindset while driving automation and STP improvement.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Career Break — Professional Development & Upskilling

03/2025 – Present

Completed Post Graduate Program in Data Science & Business Analytics (Great Lakes); currently completing a Master of Data Science at Deakin University.

Senior Business Analyst — Securities Settlement Operations Technology Credit Suisse Services AG (UBS) • Pune, India

01/2022 – 03/2025

Spearheaded trade-lifecycle timing analysis for the DTC T+1 settlement migration (capture → affirmation → settlement) and introduced automated monitoring dashboards, reducing timing-related settlement fails under compressed T+1 cut- offs.

Executed root cause and exception trend analysis on mandatory market change breaks, converting findings into targeted system enhancements and preventive controls for settlement operations.

Orchestrated impact assessment and gap analysis across 168+ regulatory and settlement reports for the Credit Suisse → UBS legal entity transition in European and Asian markets, supporting a phased, jurisdiction-approved rollout with zero disruption to reporting obligations.

Engineered application landscape rationalisation across 156+ upstream and downstream settlement applications, co- defining a criticality framework (Critical / High / Medium / Decommission) that shaped a 3-year consolidation and target operating model roadmap.

Managed implementation readiness and deployment reporting across 8+ settlement and regulatory reporting platforms including third-party vendor solutions, coordinating Technology, Operations and Compliance sign-off ahead of each release.

Served as principal liaison between Settlement Operations, Product and Technology, translating operational pain points into system change and partnering with change management to embed process and system improvements into live settlement functions.

Provided Level 1 production support for critical settlement incidents, sustaining service continuity and feeding recurring issues into the continuous improvement backlog.

Business Analyst — Settlement & Custody Operations Technology JPMorgan Chase & Co. • Bangalore, India

09/2015 – 01/2022

Participated in the SWIFT Standards Release 2017 (SR2017) implementation for Category 5 settlement messages, performing impact analysis across the MT540–MT548 range and coordinating specification, testing and production readiness with Technology and Settlement Operations.

Assessed and tested SR2017 MT54x changes buy-in settlement transaction condition code (MT540–MT543, MT548), Split Settlement conditions (MT540, MT542, MT544, MT546), the new INVM rejection reason code in MT548 and aligned triparty references (TCTR / TRCI) ahead of the November cutover.

Facilitated a multi-billion-dollar, multi-custodian custody migration covering 68,000+ asset lines, engaging 32+ agent banks across Europe and Asia to gather market-specific SWIFT settlement requirements and shape customised MT540 / MT542 instruction sets.

Attained a 97.37% pre-production testing success rate across all asset migration scenarios and coordinated controlled weekend SWIFT production releases with minimal operational disruption.

Validated SWIFT message testing and client onboarding, contributing to 100% Straight Through Processing (STP) compliance in the live environment.

Executed the Brexit-driven Luxembourg custody migration SSI updates, Free-of-Payment (FoP) asset transfers, position and cash reconciliation and cutover execution transitioning EU client assets from the UK platform.

Authored BRDs, FSDs and functional specifications for SWIFT settlement instruction workflows, translating operational requirements into scalable, reusable SWIFT / XML solutions.

Designed and executed UAT for custody migration workstreams and managed post-migration hyper care, resolving settlement exceptions and confirming stable settlement outcomes.

Manager — Trade Processing Operations JPMorgan Chase & Co. • Bangalore, India

03/2008 – 09/2015

• Directed end-to-end trade lifecycle operations across multiple securities markets trade capture, validation, confirmation, pre-matching, matching, instruction release, settlement and fails management leading a team of 7 in a high-volume, cut- off driven environment.

• Oversaw settlement execution aligned to market-specific nuances, cut-offs and settlement cycles across cross-border and

domestic markets, consistently meeting SLAs and sustaining high STP rates.

• Managed settlement fails and complex exceptions end to end investigating root causes, resolving breaks within control timelines and maintaining settlement static data and standing settlement instructions (SSIs) to reduce matching failures and repair rates.

Owned daily reconciliations across cash, position and suspense accounts, driving timely investigation and resolution of breaks with custodians and internal operations teams.

Coordinated daily with associated operations functions Corporate Actions, Securities Lending, Fund Services, Reconciliations and Settlements to resolve entitlement, position and instruction discrepancies impacting settlement. • Partnered with Front Office, Middle Office, Trading and Treasury on trade discrepancies, position queries and daily

funding inputs, minimising business and operational risk.

Engaged custodian banks, agent banks, brokers and CSDs including Euroclear, Clearstream and DTC to manage cross- border settlement processing, escalations and issue resolution.

Produced EOD and intraday MIS, processing metrics, KPI and exception reporting; applied trend analysis to surface



control breaks, process gaps and performance bottlenecks. Identified and implemented automation and process re-engineering opportunities with Technology, improving throughput, reporting accuracy and settlement STP rates.

Cultivated team resilience through structured On-the-Job Training (OJT), cross-training and capacity management, and maintained training-ready standard operating procedures supporting incident response and operational continuity.

Managed client and counterparty escalations end to end and collaborated with global operations teams across time zones on cross-border exceptions and hand-offs, ensuring continuous coverage, clear communication and accountability through to resolution.

Supported new product, new market and system launches impacting trade processing, assessing operational readiness and updating procedures and controls for market-practice changes.

Executed and documented daily key controls in line with internal policy and regulatory requirements, and maintained BCP documentation, access control matrices and compliance frameworks sustaining a control-first discipline and audit readiness across internal and external reviews.

Executive — Finance & Accounts IBM Daksh Business Process Services Private Limited. • Bangalore, India

06/2006 – 03/2008

Managed end-to-end invoice processing across multiple client accounts, including validation, PO / non-PO discrepancy resolution and payment run execution, with exception and weekly financial reporting in advanced MS Excel.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

Master of Data Science Deakin University • Geelong, Australia Distance Learning

02/2026 – Present

MBA - Finance Kousali Institute of Management Studies, Karnatak University • Dharwad, India

06/2004 – 05/2006

B. Com S.B. College of Commerce, Gulbarga University • Gulbarga, India

06/2001 – 04/2004

Post Graduate Program in Data Science & Business Analytics Great Lakes Executive Learning • Certificate No. OG3AC72JKM • CGPA 3.56

07/2024

SKILLS Trade Lifecycle Management Pre-Matching & Matching Settlement Execution Settlement Cycles & Market Cut-Offs T+1 / T+2 Settlement Settlement Fails Management Break Investigation & Resolution Root Cause Analysis Client & Counterparty Escalation Cash, Position & Suspense Reconciliations Regulatory Reporting Corporate Actions Securities Lending Fund Services Reconciliations Front & Middle Office Trading & Treasury Custodian & Agent Banks Euroclear Settlement & Middle-Office Platforms Team Leadership & Coaching Cross-Training & Succession Planning Process Re-Engineering & Automation MIS, KPI & Exception Reporting

Cross-Border & Domestic Settlement

Straight Through Processing (STP)

Daily Key Control Execution

Operational Risk & Control Frameworks

Brokers

CSDs

Clearstream DTCC / DTC T2S SWIFT MT540–MT548

SWIFT Standards Releases (SR)
